title: chionolaena lavandulifolia
intro: Chionolaena lavandulifolia, commonly known as Lavender Chionolaena, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, due to its rich array of health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chionolaena lavandulifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
